documents.text: 1919 , Mussolini founded the Italian Fasces of Combat in Milan , which became the National Fascist Party two years later . The fascists came to associate the term with the ancient Roman fasces or fascio littorio , [ 23 ] a bundle of rods tied around an axe , [ 24 ] an ancient Roman symbol of the authority of the civic magistrate , [ 25 ] carried by his lictors . [ 26 ] The symbolism of the fasces suggested strength through unity : a single rod is easily broken , while the bundle is difficult to break

The fascists came to associate the term with the ancient Roman fasces or fascio littorio , [ 23 ] a bundle of rods tied around an axe , [ 24 ] an ancient Roman symbol of the authority of the civic magistrate , [ 25 ] carried by his lictors .
